glosses: memory, recall (the ability of the brain to record information)
memory, recollection, remembrance (a record of a thing or an event stored and available for later use)
memory (the part of a computer that stores variable executable code or data)

examples.en: I have no memory of that.
You have a very good memory.

examples.text: Mio fratello ha una buona memoria.
examples.en: My brother has a good memory.
I wish I had a better memory.
